schematics.unrealzaruba.guide.title: How to upload your schematic
schematics.unrealzaruba.guide.step1: Start a single-player world and build your vehicle there; assemble it into a physical structure (Sable / Create Aeronautics) so that it moves as one piece.
schematics.unrealzaruba.guide.step2: Press "Get Tool Gun" and "Get scanner" below (the buttons work in single player only): both items appear in your inventory.
schematics.unrealzaruba.guide.step3: Check the vehicle with the Contraption Scanner: right-click it to see its size, price and publishing problems (Shift+right-click clears the panel). Fix whatever it complains about before uploading.
schematics.unrealzaruba.guide.step4: Open the Tool Gun menu (the key in Options > Controls > "Create Aeronautics: Toolgun"), pick the Save mode, aim at the vehicle and right-click: type a name and save. The blueprint goes to the shared Aeronautics folder.
schematics.unrealzaruba.guide.step5: Back here press Upload, choose the file, set a name, description and screenshots and publish. Limit: 10 schematics per player.

hud.unrealzaruba.tips.title: Tips
hud.unrealzaruba.tips.tip1: Shop and respawn only work inside your team zone.
hud.unrealzaruba.tips.tip2: Capture points by standing on them; the more of you, the faster.
hud.unrealzaruba.tips.tip3: Vehicles are bought together: anyone can chip in within 15 seconds, or everyone gets a refund.
hud.unrealzaruba.tips.tip4: Allied vehicles are marked on the map and above the vehicle.
hud.unrealzaruba.tips.tip5: Pick your respawn point before spawning: captured points move the front line.
hud.unrealzaruba.late_join.pick_team: Pick a team on the blocks (sneak on one) to join the battle
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.title: How to play
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.line1: Sneak on the block of a team to join it.
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.line2: Capture points by standing on them: the more of you, the faster. A team scores while it holds more than two points.
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.line3: The shop works at your team's respawn points. A vehicle is bought at a spawn block: anyone on the team can pay a part of the price within 15 seconds.
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.line4: Bring the supply case from a drop to an allied respawn point to cash it in.
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.line5: Waypoints in the world show only while Alt is held.
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.line6: Leaving the match outside your team's respawn zones counts as a death: what you carry is lost. In a zone you can leave freely.
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.hint_subtitle: the rules, the objectives and the controls are there
hud.unrealzaruba.rules.hint: Hold TAB: how to play, the objectives and the controls.
hud.unrealzaruba.quit.title: Leave the match?
hud.unrealzaruba.quit.text: If you leave now your character dies and everything you carry is lost.
